subject: how Hindsight lazily collects a request's spans by triggering a coordinator's backward breadcrumb traversal instead of reporting eagerly

groups.why_chosen: Instead of reporting every span immediately, Hindsight buffers locally and only pulls a request's spans, backward through its breadcrumb trail, once a trigger flags that request as worth the cost.
groups.what_to_learn: the same base topology as a sibling figure, redrawn with one new colour-coded mechanism layered on top; paired zoom-in callouts opening two components' internals from specific points on a main path
